regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative tape: Banks is the only eligible leader (trend-gate pass, durability 0.76, breadth 0.833) and is crowded (z=1.72), while the rotation radar shows Robotics & Automation leading on raw score but ineligible and unscorable. emerging_watch: Watching whether Robotics & Automation (raw leader, score 0.75, proxy-less/unscorable) flips to eligible or hands leadership to Coal — a confirmed handoff would be signalled by Coal's durability bar crossing above 0.45 while keeping breadth above 0.4; the watch retires if Robotics holds the top raw rank for 15 more sessions without eligibility.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible theme passing the absolute-trend gate, with the strongest breadth (0.833) and high durability (0.76) among eligible names — the trend discipline (the one validated leg) currently admits it. The one-narrative structure (absorbing 0.36 with only 2 of 22 themes eligible) means leadership is concentrated here, so a directional lean rather than a fade is the accountable, non-reflexive read.
theses.dissent: The same trend gate that admits Banks has historically NOT reduced drawdown on this market (backtest_verdict absolute_trend_gate 'did_NOT_hold_here'), and crowding z=1.72 with headline weight 0.25 means late-cycle attention concentration — a shake-out could hit hard, and the past 123 calls show only 0.366 directional accuracy.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average and breadth drops below 0.6 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal ranks high on raw momentum score (0.677) but is ineligible — it fails the absolute-trend gate, with durability only 0.23 and breadth 0.30 (weakest of the top ranks). The detector's only validated leg is trend-gate admission, and Coal doesn't have it. Per directive, an underweight lean is not a fade or short; it is a direction absent trend-gate confirmation.
theses.dissent: Coal is the rotation radar's challenger with score 0.677 and margin only 0.073 versus the leader, and low crowding (z=0.31) means it is not late-cycle — a mean-reverting tape could whipsaw the gate and Coal could still rally without trend admission.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS gains more than 8% relative to CSI 300 before the check-by date
